g.text: Are words with a less diverse pool in view more often repeats?
By manuscript / illustration section. Herbal A and Herbal B use the page’s Currier classification.
Same controls and calculation as the Golf chart: compare the lowest and highest fifths within bifolia, then average the three pool-size bands.
Cosmological: 172 scored manuscript words. Astrological: 75; too few qualifying targets for all three pool-size bands, so no panel.
